description: This file defines a middleware class for a FastAPI application that enforces JWT authentication on incoming HTTP requests, with certain endpoints exempted and special handling for a specific upload endpoint. It also includes logic to verify tokens, handle exceptions, and provide appropriate responses.

classes.name: AuthRequiredMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that enforces JWT authentication on all HTTP requests except a small set of explicitly allowed endpoints. It verifies JWT tokens, handles exemptions, and manages special cases like upload with admin token.

methods.name: __init__(self, app: ASGIApp)
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the app, setting exemptions, prefixes, and admin token for upload.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable)
methods.description: Main middleware logic that processes each request, checks exemption conditions, validates JWT, and handles special upload token case.

methods.name: JSONResponse _unauthorized_response(message: str)
methods.description: Generates a JSON response with 401 status for unauthorized access.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable):$/
